title: 3 file(s) are locked on Canvas and cannot be downloaded
detail: The teacher has locked them. Permanent and Canvas-side - the app reports each one by name. Excluded from the discovery gap below so a real gap is not buried under a standing condition.

title: Canvas exposes no md5 for any of this course's 42 files
detail: analyze_course's adoption tier (b) - the content match - can therefore never fire here, leaving only tier (c) (unique size+extension) for a file whose manifest row is gone. Note this does NOT weaken ordinary renames: heal_manifest Tier 2 matches on original_md5, which the app computes locally from the bytes it wrote, and works with no Canvas hash at all. Recorded because the tier-(b) comment reads as though it were the primary mechanism.

title: Download finished with 2 error(s), all teacher-locked files
detail: Errors were counted by the engine. Confirm they surfaced in the completion screen's error list rather than only in the log.
